description: This file implements a Bootstrap plugin called ScrollSpy, which tracks scrolling and updates navigation elements accordingly.

classes.name: ScrollSpy
classes.description: A class that manages scroll tracking and navigation activation based on scroll position.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Recalculates target offsets based on current DOM positions.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles scroll events to activate the appropriate navigation item.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates a specific target in the navigation, updating classes and triggering events.
